name: Layout Clone
description: Copy repeated-circuit placement and project-local footprint edits with explicit PCB selection. English and Turkish UI.
description_full: Layout Clone has separate Placement and Footprint Edits tabs. Copy anchor-relative placements or project-local pad geometry and footprint graphics to explicitly selected PCB targets. Placement matching supports mixed front/back groups and opposite-side anchors. Each placement target takes its matched source's board side, with a geometry reflection and layer conversion when needed. Preserve target identity, schematic linkage and pad nets. Includes previews, opt-in similarity suggestions, English/Turkish UI and native undo. Pad edits require matching unique numbered pads and unambiguous paste apertures; graphics-only edits preserve pads without matching them; Footprint Edits preserves target placement and board side, and automatically replaces target 3D models with the complete source model list, including paths, scale, rotation, offset, visibility and opacity. No library or schematic changes; no auto-save. Windows / KiCad 10.0 testing release. Close other PCB and schematic editors before applying. See the bundled usage notes.
